title: Purgator 1
extract:
Purgator 1 is a  Scaldra slug launcher used by Scaldra Dedicants. Shoots highly damaging single-target rounds that causes enemies to release a  Gas cloud upon their death, but carries extremely low reserve ammo and slow reload speed.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Puncture damage.
Enemies directly killed by Purgator 1 leave a  Gas status effect behind.
Innate 1.1 meter punch through and Infinite Body Punch Through
Advantages over other Primary  Launcher weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Very high crit chance (31.00%)
Very high burst DPS (1643.61)
Very high sustained DPS (1133.52)
Very high magazine size (9)
Very high damage per shot (1095.74)
Very high total damage (781)
Disadvantages over other Primary  Launcher weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Very low ammo pickup (2)
Low reload speed (2.70 s)
Low ammo max (20)
Low fire rate (1.50 attacks/sec)
Below average status chance (19.00%)
Below average disposition (●●●●○ (1.15x))
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Acquisition
Purgator 1's blueprints can be purchased from Minerva of  The Hex for  Standing; component blueprints for  5,000 and the main blueprint for  15,000 to a total of  30,000, all requiring Rank 5 - Pizza Party.
This weapon is also part of the Scaldra Dominance Pack for  655.

Notes
Enemies directly killed by the Purgator 1 leave behind 1  Gas status effect stack.
Kills must be directly from the projectile itself, not from any Damage over Time Status Effects. DoT kills will generate clouds that deal no damage.

Tips
Purgator 1's slow fire rate and innate  Impact can benefit the most from  Internal Bleeding.
The weapon can be used to make gas traps that further enemies can rush into for free, passive damage. Boosting status duration with  Hunter Track,  Continuous Misery and/or  Prismatic Gem can greatly extend the duration of the lingering cloud.
Abilities such as the Noise Arrow from  Quiver can lure enemies into the clouds while cloaked.
Abilities that speed enemies up such as  Molecular Prime can make enemies rush faster into these traps and Molecular Prime specifically also doubles the damage enemies take from the clouds.
To maximize the gas clouds as your primary source of damage,  Semi-Rifle Cannonade,  Rifle Elementalist,  Primary Acuity and  Primary Deadhead can be used to deal significant weakpoint damage to produce the strongest gas clouds.
 Mesa's  Ballistic Battery will be charged by and boost the  Gas cloud damage of the  Purgator 1.

Trivia
The Scaldra Dedicants dual wield this weapon, a feat impossible for players to replicate, similar to Executioner Dhurnam's twin  Heks. Their variant also functions differently, shooting green blobs that explode after a certain duration as opposed to the player usable version shooting slow-moving slug projectiles.
The overall design seems to be based of the Hawk MM-1 grenade launcher.
At some point shortly before release it was likely changed from firing explosive  Blast projectiles to the current slugs. This is evident in its reduced ammo capacity and reserves, found in most explosive weapons, as well as the Duviri default mod loadout featuring Blast damage. Furthermore, the concept art referred to it as a grenade launcher.
There are three pieces of Proto-Orokin text written on the weapon:
On the stock: "Property of Lasrian Military" (PRAwPEhRTEeH OwV LAhSREeHAhN MIhLUhTEhREeH)
On the scope-like attachment: Caution: FV (KAwShUhN: FV)
On the left side of the gun's chassis: Purgator-1 (POoRGTR-1)
The attachment on the right side of the gun is a laser sight, as seen in concept art. It does not function in-game.
